FULL TEXT:
MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
Mizoram New Capital Complex
Aizawl
N O T I F I C A T I O N
(LDE (Gazetted Post) No 1 of 2024 – 2025)
Dated Aizawl, the 11th June, 2024
No. A.34012/2/2023-MPSC (DR): The Mizoram Public Service Commission is going to conduct
Limited Departmental Examination for the under mentioned post. Application can be done online on
the Mizoram Public Service Commission’s online portal https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in
Applications not submitted will not be accepted even if payment is made, applicants must therefore
verify that their applications are submitted after payment for application is done.
1. Name of Department : School Education
2. Name of Post : Headmaster, Govt. High School
3. Classification : Group ‘A’ (Gazetted)
4. No. of Posts : 9 (Nine)
5. Pay : Level 10 in the Pay Matrix
6. Relevant Rules : The Mizoram School Education Department (Group ‘A’
post) Recruitment Rules, 2021
7. Conditions of Eligibility :
From trained Graduate High School Teachers and trained Graduate High School Hindi Teachers
with not less than 8 years regular service in the grade.
8. Last Date of Application : 11/07/2024
9. Admit Card Download : 19/08/2024 – 02/09/2024
10. Date of Examination : 02 – 05/09/2024
11. Syllabus for the examination is available for download on the Commission’s official website
https://mpsc.mizoram.gov.in
12. Any pertinent information regarding this advertisement will be published on the Commission’s
official website.
Candidates can contact MPSC’s Helpline No. 0389-3596493 on working days between 10:00 AM
to 4:30 PM for any information/clarification regarding their applications, candidature etc.
Sd/-ZOSANGZUALI PACHUAU
Controller of Examinations
Memo No. A.34012/2/2023-MPSC (DR) Dated Aizawl, the 11th June, 2024
Copy to:
1. Sr.PPS to Chairman, Mizoram Public Service Commission, Aizawl.
2. PPS/PS to Members, Mizoram Public Service Commission, Aizawl.
3. PA to Secretary, Mizoram Public Service Commission, Aizawl.
4. Under Secretary to the Govt. of Mizoram, School Education Department with reference
to his letter No.A.32013/1/2023-EDN(HS) dt. 24.01.2024 with a request to convey the
contents of this notification to the Director of School Education for wide circulation.
5. All Officers, Mizoram Public Service Commission.
6. All Sections, Mizoram Public Service Commission.
7. I.T. Cell, Mizoram Public Service Commission for uploading on the website.
8. Notice Board.
(NGURMUANKIMA SAILO)
Deputy Controller of Examinations
